text: Self-serve API keys are generated in User Settings under API Access and authenticate all REST API resources
quote: All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated via the Fathom website's settings area.

text: API access, including keys and webhooks, is included on all plans
quote: API access—keys and webhooks— are included on all plans. Generate a key in User Settings → API Access.

text: The API lists recent meetings recorded by you or shared to your team
quote: List the 10 most recent meetings recorded by you or shared to your team.

text: Webhooks send meeting data, optionally with summary, transcript, and action items, to a URL you choose
quote: Webhooks will send your meeting data (optionally including the summary, transcript, and action items) to a URL of your choice.

text: Webhooks can be created via the API with options to include transcript, CRM matches, summary, or action items
quote: Create a webhook to receive new meeting content. At least one of `include_transcript`, `include_crm_matches`, `include_summary`, or `include_action_items` must be true.

text: Webhooks can be deleted via the API
quote: Delete a webhook.

text: Each webhook request carries a signature header so you can verify the payload is authentic and unaltered
quote: Each webhook request sent from Fathom includes a signature in the request headers, which you can use to confirm the authenticity of the payload.

text: The SDK provides a verifyWebhook helper to validate incoming webhook requests
quote: If you're using our SDK, you can use the verify_webhook helper. Simply call: Fathom.verifyWebhook(webhook_secret, request.headers, request.body)

text: Official TypeScript and Python SDKs are available
quote: Use our Typescript or Python SDK.

text: The SDKs handle authentication, pagination, and error handling for you
quote: Get started in minutes with our official SDKs. They handle authentication, pagination, error handling, and all the complex stuff so you can focus on building amazing integrations.

text: The SDKs automatically retry rate-limited requests, honoring the Retry-After header
quote: The official SDKs automatically retry rate-limited requests, waiting for the duration indicated by the `Retry-After` header.

text: The SDKs support OAuth 2.0 for integrations installable by multiple Fathom accounts
quote: Both TypeScript and Python SDKs support OAuth 2.0 authentication for building integrations that can be installed by multiple Fathom accounts.

text: The Python SDK can be used interactively in a shell via uv/uvx
quote: You can use this SDK in a Python shell with uv and the `uvx` command

text: Developers can build public OAuth apps that other Fathom users install
quote: If you're developing a public app that you wish to integrate with Fathom, you should build it using OAuth.

text: OAuth apps are eligible for App Marketplace visibility and co-marketing from Fathom
quote: OAuth apps are eligible for promotion by Fathom and can unlock visibility in our App Marketplace, as well as co-marketing opportunities.

text: A download-recording endpoint generates a file asynchronously, returning a download_id to poll and then a short-lived signed URL
quote: Starts async generation of a downloadable file and returns a `download_id` to poll.

text: An admin-only endpoint lists all users in the account with their permissions
quote: List all users in the account with their permissions. Admin only.

text: The get-summary endpoint returns the call summary directly, or POSTs it asynchronously to a destination_url
quote: If you send `destination_url`, the endpoint will behave in an asynchronous manner. If you do not send `destination_url`, the endpoint will return the data directly.

text: Meetings can be filtered by associated company domain
quote: Returns meetings whose associated company matches one of the specified domains.

text: Meeting types can be listed and used as a meeting_type filter on GET /meetings
quote: Use the returned `name` values as the meeting_type filter on GET /meetings.

text: Teams can be listed and used to filter meetings by team
quote: summary: List teams operationId: listTeams

text: API responses and webhooks include the meeting_url
quote: Added `meeting_url` to API response and webhooks.

text: An official MCP server connects Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude
quote: Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.

text: Fathom is available as an official connector in Claude
quote: Fathom is available as an **official connector** in Claude

text: The Fathom MCP server can be added to Claude Code from the command line
quote: claude mcp add fathom -- npx mcp-remote@latest https://api.fathom.ai/mcp

text: Any MCP-compatible tool can connect via the server URL and authenticate to access meeting data
quote: Connect Fathom to any MCP-compatible tool using the server URL below, then authenticate to access your meeting data.
